scripts.build:ev: vite build --config vite.config.ev.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist-ev/index-ev.html';const t='dist-ev/index.html';if(fs.existsSync(p))fs.renameSync(p,t);fs.writeFileSync('dist-ev/.nojekyll','');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && gh-pages -d dist -b gh-pages -r https://github.com/capitalchuan/market-research.git -m "Deploy web build to gh-pages"
scripts.deploy:ev: npm run build:ev && gh-pages -d dist-ev -b gh-pages -e ev -r https://github.com/capitalchuan/market-research.git -m "Deploy EV asset portfolio to gh-pages/ev"
